consumer.optionalInstall: Only the four pinned original PDFs, only under reference/chat-parallel-2026-09-07/chat6/. consumer.selection: Use --only ut, --only me or --only il to consume a single transport. Download the original named ZIP, not a recompressed copy.
consumer.destinationCaution: Run only in the caller's own destination worktree. Chat6 has not accessed or installed in A/Chat3 worktrees. Script output identifies the actual destination and per-file readback; retain that output before stamping installation.
